name: dna-visualization
description: Scale — a scroll-driven descent from tissue to the double helix. Nine continuously crossfading biological scales: a drifting cell field, a cell interior, the nucleus, a chromosome unwinding into chromatin, the B-DNA double helix with a real sequence, base-pair chemistry, transcription, translation and protein folding, and a protein interaction network. Angular 21 (zoneless, signals) over a hand-written WebGL2 / GLSL ES 3.0 renderer with no 3D engine, no math library and no binary assets.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:glsl && npm run check:bio
